intent: Implement the google-calendar /push Edge Function route: push app events to linked shared Google calendars, idempotently, per the google-integration.md spec.
summary: Implemented the /push route (was a stub) in supabase/functions/google-calendar/index.ts plus a pure-logic module push.ts with deterministic Google event IDs (UUID hex), event mapper (all-day date vs timed dateTime+Asia/Jakarta, RRULE prefix, private p3md_event_id property), and reconcilePush which handles op=delete and op=upsert (push to desired calendars matching audience role/group, POST-then-PUT-on-409 idempotency, and deletion of links no longer desired). Routed it into index.ts with 400/404/source-skip guards and DB upsert/delete of event_google_links rows. Added push.test.ts (9 cases) covering the mapper, delete-by-links, upsert reconciliation, audience gating, POST-409-PUT fallback, and stale-link cleanup; 15/15 unit tests pass across sync+push. Verified the handler end-to-end against local Supabase: empty body -> 400, nonexistent event upsert -> 404, delete with empty links -> 200 {ok, pushed:0, deleted:0}. Full DB suite (10 files, 135 pgTAP) still passes; agent:check, frontend lint + typecheck + 23 unit tests all green. Marked partial: live-POST to Google is covered by unit tests (mocked gfetch) but not an end-to-end API call, because no Google calendar is shared with the service account yet (gated by PSI-062's human step).

decisions.decision: Deterministic Google event ID = UUID hex with dashes stripped
decisions.reason: UUID hex (0-9a-f) is a strict subset of base32hex, which Google accepts for custom event ids; makes repeated pushes idempotent and enables POST-then-PUT-on-409

decisions.decision: Push logic kept in push.ts free of Deno/Supabase runtime imports (scope constant local)
decisions.reason: Keeps reconcilePush unit-testable under bun without the npm:jose Deno import that _shared/google.ts pulls in

decisions.decision: op defaults to upsert; handler skips events whose source is not 'app'
decisions.reason: Loop prevention: google-pulled events (source='google') must never be pushed back to Google; /sync owns that path

verification.manual: bun test supabase/functions/google-calendar/ 15/15; bun test src/ 23/23; frontend lint clean; tsc clean; agent:check ok (83 tasks, 57 entries). supabase test db: 10 files, 135 tests pass. Live handler probes: empty body -> 400, nonexistent event upsert -> 404, delete empty-links -> 200 {ok:true,pushed:0,deleted:0}.
